condition: Traceback.extract loops forever and grows memory without bound when an exception chain forms a cycle through __cause__ and __context__, e.g. when an exception is re-raised inside the handler of another exception that was raised from it.
workaround: Avoid re-raising the original exception inside the handler of an exception chained from it (for example, use bare `raise` or `raise ... from None`), or break the cycle by clearing __context__/__cause__ before passing the exception to rich.
